sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="storage_write",
    target="run_analyzer.py",
    metadata={"location": "exp_001"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="submit",
    target="Axiom Repro: Stage Dependencies",
    metadata={"eval_id": 284}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="submit",
    target="Log Tick 126 Actions",
    metadata={"eval_id": 285}
)
